F16.how: python3 scripts/newton/voice/swap_take.py F16 <the farm's take, mp3 or wav> --dry-run, then without --dry-run. THE CUT STEP: the farm renders F16 as a two-voice dialogue after Newton's F15, so swap_take reads the farm's report.json (the one beside the take, or --report) and cuts F16's own voice segment out in the silence before it (the envelope, cut_lines' rule; never at the service's segment boundary), then trims it the cut_lines way; it refuses a clip longer than max_s (next.est_s + 1.0 s), then rebuilds (assemble.py, gen_timing.py, hot_syllables.py --build: the new take's clip gain). Then the sound mix rebuild and the renders; --back returns to the take before

The picture freezes on B03's last frame for the card's 75 frames; B04 starts 2.50 s later. was_fallback.why: the stopped run believed the film had to stay under 3:00 and used the plan's fallback; the format allows 2:40-3:25 (day-in-life-film), so the full gaps are in

title_note.why: Jay's rule (18:05; the format skill): the title card's only words are 采访XXX的一天. The film's name changed from 跟着牛顿过一天 to 采访牛顿的一天. No subtitle row on the title: the date and place moved to Newton's intro card (EFFECTS_PLAN row 4, drawn by the skin's card in hud/ms). title_span_s is the plan's window from the slam's thud (5.90 s, f177) for 1.87 s to 7.77 s (in 0.6 s, held 1.0 s, out 0.27 s; TITLE_RAW f177-f232, 56 frames), gone before A03 at 7.80 s (f234) with G1's full 1.20 s. The old TitleCard (hud/title.tsx) is no longer mounted; skin A's MsTitle (hud/ms) draws the title.

r3.why: title_span_s is the title's REAL window now: skin A's MsTitle (hud/ms/when.ts TITLE_FROM) starts on the slam's audible thud, A02 end + 0.37 + 0.27 s = f184 (segA's SND.thud; director r1 note 4), and TITLE_LEN resolves to 50 frames, so the title is f184-233 (6.1333-7.8 s, TITLE_RAW f184-f233), gone the frame before A03's whisper bubble at f234. gen_timing.py ends any caption's linger the frame before TITLE_RAW's first frame (the owner's rule: the title never shares the screen with a subtitle); A02's subtitle already ends on f177 on this voice track.
